title: Behram Khurshid Pesikaka v. State of Bombay

content.caseIdentity: Behram Khurshid Pesikaka v. State of Bombay, AIR 1955 SC 123
content.holding: Fundamental Rights are a matter of public policy and structural limitations on State power, not mere individual privileges; they cannot be waived by an individual.
content.relevance: Foundational authority holding Part III rights non-waivable.
